{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication
dedup_count = len(data_dedup)
original_count = len(data)
print(f'Original rows: {original_count}')
print(f'Deduplicated patients: {dedup_count}')
print(f'Number of re-tested patients: {original_count - dedup_count}')

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', data_dedup['assay_batch'].unique())
print('\nSample of biomarker_final values for batch B:', data_dedup[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].head())

# Correct batch B values: divide by 10 (since batch B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL)
data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
data_dedup.loc[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Verify correction
corrected_batch_b = data_dedup[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final_corrected'].describe()
print('\nDescriptive stats for batch B after correction:', corrected_batch_b)

# Compute mean biomarker_final in ng/mL across all patients
total_mean = data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f'\nMean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {total_mean}')"}
